name: Hashtag Generator
description: Turn a short topic or description into a ready-to-paste set of relevant hashtags for Instagram, X, TikTok or LinkedIn.
body:
Your hashtags

Your hashtags will appear here.

Auto-generated from a built-in dictionary — review for relevance before posting.
howto: Describe your post topic or paste a short caption.
Choose how many hashtags you want (3–30).
Optionally enable CamelCase for multi-word tags.
Copy the ready-to-paste list and add it to your post.
features: Template-based hashtag generation from a built-in topic dictionary
Relevance scoring based on your input words

faq.a: The tool extracts meaningful words from your topic and matches them against a built-in dictionary of common hashtags, then adds related tags. It runs on your device — no AI calls.

faq.q: How many hashtags should I use?
faq.a: Instagram commonly supports up to 30. For X/Twitter and LinkedIn fewer works better (3–5). This tool lets you pick any number from 3 to 30.
Writing multi-word tags without spaces but with capital letters, like #LatteArt. It keeps the tag readable and often performs better on Instagram.

faq.q: Will these hashtags work on every platform?
faq.a: They are generated generally, so always check platform-specific rules and trending tags in your niche before posting.
